strings.en: Suspending the game?
Hmph, a shame, just when my Tenku Shinken was about to roar.
Well, fine. I'll cut loose next time you play.
Those stained by greed, blind to the truth... I'll cut them down! Jeeeeet!
Brother! Hey, Brother Rom~!
Geez, where'd he go?
Fine, I'll do it then!
Every beginning has an end... Every save has a continue...
People call this... suspending.
Be sure to play the rest! That's Leina's wish!
Every beginning has an end...
Every save has a continue...
People call this... suspending.
Fight hard in your next battle too.
May Kenrou guide you as well.
I-Is it... over already?
Come on, Mia. It's not like this is goodbye.
Quit moping, Mia. C'mon, Roll. Wrap it up like a man.
O-Okay. Um, please play again next time...
That's not manly!
Next time! Into this Super Robot Wars... Cross Fight!
No in-between with him, huh...
Ending...? Heh... heh heh heh... Afraid of the space pirates, the Bunker?
...What? I'm the one who won't shut up about Mia Alice?
Tenacity is exactly what a space pirate needs.
You'd do well to play with tenacity too... heh heh heh...
Hello, Inez Fressange here.
Suspending the game...?
Shall I explain what you're thinking right now?
First, it's late at night... so you came to see this ending message, right?
Good kids, off to bed. Bad kids... suit yourselves.
See you next time, let's all play Super Robot Wars!
Guts!
Now's when the great Gai Daigoji's dazzling exploits begin...
Hey, hey, you're quitting!?
These are super robots! Super robots! Play without sleeping!!
...Well, I'll let you off for today, but next time for sure!
Now, for the next session... Let's Gekigain!
Okay, it's over. Bye. Huh? Too short? Say more? ...A catchphrase?
I'm the real robot type, so a catchphrase... Hmm... Well then...
"Bunch of idiots..."
...That'll do, once in a while.
Haah, I'm beat. Being captain isn't easy either, you know, Akito?
Don't ask me. I may be a pilot, but I want to be a cook.
Oh, you! You're worried about me, aren't you!? Akito!
No, I mean... listen to me, Yurika!
Yurika's gonna give it everything she's got!
So everyone, be sure to play next time! That's a captain's order!
...Please do.
Um... My name is Romina Radorio... I have come
from the Shema system, 60,000 light-years from your solar system,
seeking the legendary ninja... Huh? This isn't a greeting?
...Yes, a farewell... for ending the game? ...My apologies.
Then please be sure to play next time.
Oh, and if you find the ninja... please let me know.
Whew, I'm tired, Aina.
Yes. ...But... as long as I'm with you, Shiro... I...
Aina...
Lady Aina, we must give our farewell for ending the game...
Shiro...
...Ahem. We shall await your next session.
What, we're done?
I thought we'd just push straight through.
Oh, who cares? Let's take it easy.
Yeah, guess so. Then Tobikage's entrance will be next session...
Whoa!? Tobikage!? It's too early!
Wow, finished already? Kids these days have no stamina.
It's a long game. Besides, games are one hour a day.
So stiff, Kyosuke. ...Then again, isn't one hour a day kind of short?
Who knows.
Geez, own up to what you say. Well then, until next time...
Oh, wait a sec!
What is it?
...What are you doing?
Huh? Oh, I figured for some folks, I'd look like this... Hee hee!
Good grief.
Good work. Looks like you tried hard. Go on and get some rest.
But I'd like you to resume as soon as you can.
Don't forget that our fate rests in your hands.
Now, for the next session... Come ooon heeere!!
Koji, looks like that's it for today.
Whew, thank goodness...
Then let's take a breather ourselves.
Yeah. Same time tomorrow, then... Mazin!
Go!!
Getting tired? Then you'd better get some good rest.
Long gaming sessions aren't good for you. Pick it up again next time.
Until then, come back here and... Switch on!!
Hey, hey, quitting already? Guess you're not as tough as I thought.
A real man goes all in, no saves till the end, full blast.
...Is what I'd like to say, but
if I push it too far, Sara'll chew me out again,
so I'll let it slide this time. See ya, play with us again.
The watchword is... Super Robot Wars, let's do this!!
